Jean Piaget was a famous Swiss psychologist who gained worldwide recognition for his studies of the thought processes of children.

Piaget outlined four principle stages of concept formation.�

A concept refers to the meaning an individual gives to various objects or abstract ideas. Concept formation refers to the way we build these ideas in our minds.

For example: You can picture concept formation as being the process a child goes through when assembling interlocking blocks to make various shapes and structures.
